name: Ersatz Eye

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: An artificial eye that replaces a lost one and sees as well.
text: An artificial eye made to fill a socket whose eye was lost or taken out. Once seated in the socket, only you can remove it, and you see through the little orb just as you would through a natural eye. (It has no further effect in the game.)
